entries.target_zh_TW: 叛軍在那裡！

entries.target_zh_TW: 把他帶進來。

entries.target_zh_TW: 正在離開隱密的反抗軍訓練設施。

entries.target_zh_TW: 返回不屈號。

entries.target_zh_TW: 圖卡納行星附近的滅星者巡邏隊

entries.source: Sir, our TIE Interceptors have located a
entries.target_zh_TW: 長官，我們的鈦攔截機發現了

entries.source: Rebel Fleet orbiting the planet Turkana.
entries.target_zh_TW: 一支在圖卡納行星軌道上的叛軍艦隊。

entries.source: Excellent!  Prepare the attack.
entries.target_zh_TW: 很好！準備進攻。

entries.source: Move our Star Destroyers within range
entries.target_zh_TW: 把我們的滅星者移進射程內，

entries.source: and launch all TIE Fighter Squadrons.
entries.target_zh_TW: 並派出所有鈦戰機中隊。

entries.source: At once, Sir!
entries.target_zh_TW: 遵命，長官！

entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍旗艦獨立號艦上。

entries.source: We are under attack by Imperial Star Destroyers!
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們遭到帝國滅星者攻擊！

entries.source: Begin evasive maneuvers.  Launch the X-Wing fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: 開始迴避機動。派出 X翼戰機。

entries.source: This is Red Leader.  Stay close
entries.target_zh_TW: 這裡是紅色隊長。保持隊形，

entries.source: and watch for enemy fighters.
entries.target_zh_TW: 注意敵方戰機。

entries.source: I got him.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我擊落他了。

entries.source: Follow me.
entries.target_zh_TW: 跟我來。

entries.source: I can't shake him!
entries.target_zh_TW: 我甩不掉他！

entries.source: I'm on him.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我咬住他了。

entries.source: Nice shot, Red Two!
entries.target_zh_TW: 打得好，紅色二號！

entries.source: Star Destroyer fleet orbiting a
entries.target_zh_TW: 滅星者艦隊在軌道上包圍

entries.source: Rebel base on the planet Orion IV.
entries.target_zh_TW: 奧瑞恩四號星的反抗軍基地。

entries.source: AT-AT Walkers advance on the Rebel base.
entries.target_zh_TW: AT-AT 步行機向反抗軍基地推進。

entries.source: Planet has been secured.
entries.target_zh_TW: 行星已經拿下。

entries.source: Rebel agents on approach to Star Destroyer Invincible.
entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍特務正接近滅星者無敵號。

entries.source: Security codes approved.  Shuttle landing in Main Bay.
entries.target_zh_TW: 安全密碼核准。穿梭機降落於主機庫。

entries.source: Is that it?
entries.target_zh_TW: 就這些了嗎？

entries.source: Yes, that's the last crate.
entries.target_zh_TW: 對，這是最後一箱。

entries.source: Alright, lift off.
entries.target_zh_TW: 好，起飛。

entries.source: Hidden among the crates, the Rebels have
entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍在貨箱之間

entries.source: planted a powerful explosive device.
entries.target_zh_TW: 藏了一枚威力強大的爆炸裝置。

entries.source: Rebel Corvette deploying captured
entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍護衛艦正在部署擄獲的

entries.source: Imperial Communication Satellites.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國通訊衛星。

entries.source: The modified CommSats scatter into deep space.
entries.target_zh_TW: 改裝過的通訊衛星散布到深太空中。

entries.source: A lone CommSat transmits near the Cron Drift,
entries.target_zh_TW: 一顆孤立的通訊衛星在克朗漂流帶附近發送訊號，

entries.source: sending Imperial data to a nearby Rebel outpost.
entries.target_zh_TW: 將帝國資料傳給鄰近的反抗軍前哨站。

entries.source: Rebel listening post Ax-235 in an
entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍監聽站 Ax-235 位於

entries.source: asteroid field within the Cron Drift.
entries.target_zh_TW: 克朗漂流帶內的小行星帶中。

entries.source: We just intercepted a transmission.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我們剛攔截到一段通訊。

entries.source: Sounds like an Imperial code.
entries.target_zh_TW: 聽起來像是帝國的密碼。

entries.source: That's right!  I'm decoding it now.
entries.target_zh_TW: 沒錯！我正在解碼。

entries.source: Looks like plans for an Imperial Battle Station!
entries.target_zh_TW: 看起來像是帝國戰鬥太空站的藍圖！

entries.source: Relay it with the next High Security transmissions.
entries.target_zh_TW: 跟著下一批高度機密通訊一起轉發出去。

entries.source: Enroute to the planet Alderaan, the Corellian Corvette
entries.target_zh_TW: 柯瑞利亞護衛艦載著莉亞公主前往奧德蘭，

entries.source: transporting Princess Leia receives a vital message.
entries.target_zh_TW: 途中收到一則重要訊息。

entries.source: Here are the secret plans, Princess Leia.
entries.target_zh_TW: 莉亞公主，這是秘密藍圖。

entries.source: I will bring them safely to Alderaan.
entries.target_zh_TW: 我會把它們安全送到奧德蘭。

entries.source: Imperial Fleet on course for Tatooine.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國艦隊正航向塔圖因星。

entries.source: I have you now!
entries.target_zh_TW: 你逃不掉了！

entries.source: Imperial Death Star in final stages of construction.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國死星進入最後建造階段。

entries.source: Arrival of Darth Vader, Envoy of the Emperor.
entries.target_zh_TW: 皇帝特使達斯·維達駕到。

entries.source: Congratulations, the Death Star is
entries.target_zh_TW: 恭喜，死星已經

entries.source: complete.  The Emperor will be pleased.
entries.target_zh_TW: 完工。皇帝會很高興的。

entries.source: I think it is time we demonstrated
entries.target_zh_TW: 我想是時候展示

entries.source: the full power of this station.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這座太空站的全部威力了。

entries.source: This station is insignificant compared
entries.target_zh_TW: 這座太空站和原力的力量相比

entries.source: with the power of the force.
entries.target_zh_TW: 根本微不足道。

entries.source: You may fire when ready.
entries.target_zh_TW: 準備好就可以開火。

entries.source: Imperial Death Star on approach to Alderaan.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國死星正逼近奧德蘭。

entries.source: You may fire when ready.
entries.target_zh_TW: 準備好就可以開火。

entries.source: Approaching Yavin Moon Base.
entries.target_zh_TW: 接近雅文衛星基地。

entries.source: Yavin Rebel Base.  Headquarters of the Rebellion.
entries.target_zh_TW: 雅文反抗軍基地。反抗軍的總部。

entries.source: Darth Vader's shuttle arrives at Plooriod III.
entries.target_zh_TW: 達斯·維達的穿梭機抵達普魯里奧德三號星。

entries.source: Lord Vader!  What a great privilege to have
entries.target_zh_TW: 維達大人！真是莫大的榮幸，

entries.source: you unexpectedly grace my humble domain.
entries.target_zh_TW: 您竟出乎意料地蒞臨寒舍。

entries.source: How may I serve you?
entries.target_zh_TW: 有什麼能為您效勞的嗎？

entries.source: We received your grain shipments, Ghorin...
entries.target_zh_TW: 戈林，我們收到你送來的穀物了……

entries.source: and the Emperor has sent me here to
entries.target_zh_TW: 而皇帝派我來

entries.source: personally repay you for your treachery.
entries.target_zh_TW: 親自回報你的背叛。

entries.source: Imperial Drydock IV, Greater Plooriad Sector.
entries.target_zh_TW: 帝國第四乾塢，大普魯里奧德星區。

entries.source: Interdictor Cruisers respond to Fleet Summons.
entries.target_zh_TW: 禁制者級巡洋艦響應艦隊集結令。

entries.source: Outer Rim Imperial Fleet preparing for battle.
entries.target_zh_TW: 外環帝國艦隊正在備戰。

entries.source: Interdictors join the fleet for attack on Rebels.
entries.target_zh_TW: 禁制者級巡洋艦加入艦隊，準備進攻反抗軍。

entries.source: Ramming course locked in.
entries.target_zh_TW: 衝撞航線已鎖定。

entries.source: Right!  Let's get out of here.
entries.target_zh_TW: 好！我們快離開這裡。

entries.source: New B-wings arrive at Rebel Fleet.
entries.target_zh_TW: 新的 B翼戰機抵達反抗軍艦隊。

entries.source: Lt. Farlander, do you have
entries.target_zh_TW: 法蘭德中尉，

entries.source: the B-wings combat-ready?
entries.target_zh_TW: B翼戰機可以投入戰鬥了嗎？

entries.source: Yes Cmdr. Skywalker, they will be a
entries.target_zh_TW: 是的，天行者中校，它們將成為

entries.source: powerful new weapon against the Empire.
entries.target_zh_TW: 對抗帝國的強大新武器。

entries.source: Good work, Lieutenant.
entries.target_zh_TW: 做得好，中尉。

entries.source: Two Rebel ships work in conjunction to replace
entries.target_zh_TW: 兩艘反抗軍艦艇協同作業，

entries.source: Imperial probes with modified Rebel probes.
entries.target_zh_TW: 以改裝的反抗軍探測器替換帝國探測器。

entries.source: Inside the cargo ship, modified probes are
entries.target_zh_TW: 在貨船內，改裝過的探測器

entries.source: readied for release.
entries.target_zh_TW: 已準備就緒，隨時可以投放。

entries.source: Each Imperial probe is replaced in a quick swap.
entries.target_zh_TW: 每個帝國探測器都在瞬間被調包。

entries.source: Rebel Fleet arrives at the planet Hoth.
entries.target_zh_TW: 反抗軍艦隊抵達霍斯星。

entries.source: General, what word is there of
entries.target_zh_TW: 將軍，從哈巴薩撤離的情況

entries.source: our evacuation from Habassa?
entries.target_zh_TW: 有什麼消息嗎？

entries.source: The fleet has arrived safely, Princess.
entries.target_zh_TW: 公主，艦隊已安全抵達。

entries.source: Thank goodness.  Is our Hoth base operational?
entries.target_zh_TW: 謝天謝地。我們的霍斯基地可以運作了嗎？

entries.source: Yes, the Rebel Alliance has
entries.target_zh_TW: 是的，反抗軍聯盟

entries.source: found a new home.
entries.target_zh_TW: 找到了新家園。

entries.source: Congratulations on behalf of the Rebel Alliance.
entries.target_zh_TW: 謹代表反抗軍聯盟向你致賀。

entries.source: Returning to the hidden Rebel Training Facilities.
entries.target_zh_TW: 返回隱密的反抗軍訓練設施。

entries.source: Leaving the Alliance Flagship Independence.
entries.target_zh_TW: 正在離開聯盟旗艦獨立號。

entries.source: Preparing for the jump to hyperspace.
entries.target_zh_TW: 準備躍入超空間。

entries.source: Arriving at the hidden Rebel Training Facilities.
entries.target_zh_TW: 抵達隱密的反抗軍訓練設施。

entries.target_zh_TW: 抵達隱密的反抗軍戰鬥訓練設施。

entries.source: Arriving at the Calamari Cruiser Defiance.
entries.target_zh_TW: 抵達卡拉馬里巡洋艦不屈號。

entries.source: Returning to Independence.
entries.target_zh_TW: 返回獨立號。

entries.target_zh_TW: 這裡是紅色隊長。別在意，

entries.source: about it.  Try again.
entries.target_zh_TW: 再試一次。

entries.source: This is Red Leader.  Not bad.
entries.target_zh_TW: 這裡是紅色隊長。還不錯。

entries.source: But you still need training.
entries.target_zh_TW: 但你仍需要訓練。

entries.source: This is Red Leader.  Excellent!
entries.target_zh_TW: 這裡是紅色隊長。太出色了！

entries.source: You're ready for combat!
entries.target_zh_TW: 你已經可以上戰場了！

entries.source:
An Imperial fleet is heading for
the Rebel Base at Ralltir.  You
must try to delay the attack.
entries.target_zh_TW:
一支帝國艦隊正前往
拉爾提爾星的反抗軍基地。
你必須設法拖延這場攻擊。

entries.source:
An Imperial fleet is heading for
the Rebel Base at Ralltir.  You
must try to delay the attack.
entries.target_zh_TW:
一支帝國艦隊正前往
拉爾提爾星的反抗軍基地。
你必須設法拖延這場攻擊。

entries.source:
The Imperial Fleet is attacking
a Rebel Base with AT-AT walkers
and Assault Gunboats.
entries.target_zh_TW:
帝國艦隊出動 AT-AT 步行機
與突擊砲艇，
進攻一座反抗軍基地。

entries.source:
The Rebels sneak on board an
Imperial Star Destroyer and
plant a bomb.
entries.target_zh_TW:
反抗軍潛入一艘
帝國滅星者，
並安置了一枚炸彈。

entries.source:
The plans for the Death Star
are intercepted by a Rebel
outpost.
entries.target_zh_TW:
一座反抗軍前哨站
攔截到了
死星藍圖。

entries.source:
The plans for the Death Star
are transmitted to the ship
containing Princess Leia.
entries.target_zh_TW:
死星藍圖被傳送到
載著莉亞公主的
艦艇上。

entries.source:
The Death Star is completed
and destroys the planet used
for building resources.
entries.target_zh_TW:
死星完工，並摧毀了
為其提供建造資源的
那顆行星。

entries.source:
The Death Star destroys the
planet Alderaan as a means of
terrorizing the galaxy.
entries.target_zh_TW:
死星摧毀了
奧德蘭行星，
藉此威嚇整個銀河。

entries.source:
The Death Star is destroyed
by a Rebel attack.  The rebels
return to Yavin to celebrate.
entries.target_zh_TW:
死星被反抗軍的
攻擊摧毀。反抗軍
返回雅文慶祝。

entries.source:
The Rebels flee from Yavin
before the Imperial Fleet
can retaliate.
entries.target_zh_TW:
反抗軍搶在帝國艦隊
展開報復之前
撤離雅文。

entries.source:
Overlord Ghorin is killed
by Darth Vader for giving
poison grain to the empire.
entries.target_zh_TW:
戈林霸主因向帝國
供應有毒穀物，
遭達斯·維達處決。

entries.source:
Imperial Interdictors are
taken from a repair dock to
join the main Imperial Fleet.
entries.target_zh_TW:
帝國的禁制者級巡洋艦
駛離維修船塢，
加入帝國主力艦隊。

entries.source:
An unprotected Imperial
repair dock is rammed by an
unmanned Rebel Corvette.
entries.target_zh_TW:
一座毫無防護的帝國
維修船塢遭一艘無人駕駛的
反抗軍護衛艦衝撞。

entries.source:
The B-Wing Starfighter
is brought on-line by Luke
Skywalker and Lt. Farlander.
entries.target_zh_TW:
路克·天行者與法蘭德中尉
讓 B翼星際戰機
正式投入服役。

entries.source:
The Rebel Alliance swaps
Imperial Probes with Rebel
Probes during an evacuation.
entries.target_zh_TW:
反抗軍聯盟在撤離期間
以反抗軍探測器
調包帝國探測器。

entries.source:
The Rebellion arrives at
Hoth, where a new base for the
Rebel Alliance will be built.
entries.target_zh_TW:
反抗軍抵達霍斯星，
將在此為反抗軍聯盟
建立新基地。
